definition_zh: 按增量平衡近似更新结构响应的方法。
usage_overview: 准静态增量法用于按增量形式更新结构响应。在所述动力分析中，动力方程被离散为等效刚度增量方程，其中仍计入惯性和阻尼的贡献。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: Then, a consistent tangent modulus of damaged material is derived, and the quasi-static incremental method is applied to obtain the dynamic response of the track considering the material fatigue damage.

For achieving the nonlinear dynamic analysis of the track subsystem considering the fatigue damage of concrete, a quasi-static incremental method is developed based on the Houbolt method [56], and the corresponding incremental formulation will be provided in the subsequent subsection by integrating the tangent stiffness matrix of materials and finite element method.
